name: Wallwrecker
text: The general's moves and charges may pass across terrain features as though it could fly. It does not gain the Fly keyword.

name: Lungburster
text: When a friendly unit wholly within 9" of the general (the general counts) rolls a 1, 2 or 3 for its run roll, it may use 4 instead.

name: Deathcheater
text: The general has Ward (6+) while it is more than 3" from every other friendly unit.

name: Gristlegobbler
text: Once per battle, at the end of any turn, each enemy unit in combat with the general suffers D3 mortal damage, then the general Heals (3).
